name: claude-kit
description: Reusable Claude Code skills and hooks, grouped by direction

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Hook: blocks git commit and git push on main/master, except the first commit and first push of a new repository

plugins.name: locator-converter
plugins.description: Skill build: plan, build and audit a converter between test locator languages (XPath to class chain, UiSelector, …) with a device oracle, exact/close/skip outcomes and fixed scoring

plugins.name: mobile-test-runs
plugins.description: Skills ios-simulator, ios-real-device, android-emulator + hooks: device tests and timing benchmarks only on AC power with Low Power Mode off, under caffeinate, headless emulator, new devices only with consent, background runs with a monitor and --resume

plugins.name: llm-benchmark
plugins.description: Skill llm-vs-tool + hook: compare LLMs against a deterministic tool — isolated chunked runs with --resume, one prompt, the tool as 100 %, WRONG on its own line, cost and time per run, effort at most xhigh

plugins.name: publishing
plugins.description: Skills npm-release, devto-article, github-pages-playground + hook: README as the npm page, bin bit, bump PR from main, tag and GitHub release on publish day; dev.to format, PNG charts, cover, nothing unreleased, link back; a Pages playground built from the library with a parity check; only the user runs npm publish

plugins.name: project-kit
plugins.description: Skills kickoff and retro: start a project with a health check, the kit plugins that fit, CLAUDE.md and PLAN.md from templates with an estimate per stage; review it by turning feedback memory into missing rules, repeated violations into hook candidates, duplicated rules into one copy and unused skills into new descriptions or removals, as a PR to the kit
